answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the orchard queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 972 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vertex. The violet index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each impostor pays 7 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
